subject: Security exhibit — legal gate review and evidence ramp
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Legal Team <legal@arborhealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arborhealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit — legal gate review and evidence ramp

Hi Sofia / Arbor Legal team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. I've attached a first-pass security exhibit tailored to the ArborHealth MSA + order form — the doc highlights the audit-rights language, proposed pen-test access model, and a suggested SOC 2 evidence cadence. Key asks from our side:

- Please confirm whether your legal gate requires explicit SaaS-hosting attestations for KMS/HSM usage and outbound log retention windows.
- We propose a staged pen-test: (i) staging-only blackbox window, (ii) production read-only smoke test with scoped credentials, and (iii) post-test evidence handback. See the pen-test-playbook.pdf attached.
- Proposed evidence ramp: 2-week SOC2 evidence handoff for initial order form; monthly rolling exports afterward for audit customers. See evidence-cadence-table.xlsx.

Attachments: redlines-security-exhibit.docx (redline), pen-test-playbook.pdf, evidence-cadence-table.xlsx

Can your team review legal redlines in the exhibit and comment on the pen-test access model by EOD Friday? If there are procurement constraints (e.g., order-form language that must stay intact), flag those so we can propose alternate wording.

Next step: I can book a 30-min legal gate review on Monday to walk through redlines if that helps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arborhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@arborhealth.com>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@arborhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — legal gate review and evidence ramp

Vanessa, thanks for the materials. A few quick clarifying questions before we route to procurement/legal:

1) Pen-test scope — when you say "production read-only smoke test with scoped credentials", do you mean a time-limited IAM role that can only call inference endpoints? We need explicit guarantees about no data exfiltration and no writes.
2) SOC 2 evidence cadence — Arbor procurement prefers quarterly bundles rather than monthly exports for vendor compliance. Can Redwood do a quarterly consolidated package (with ad-hoc extracts on request)?
3) Order form redlines — our legal team will want to keep the core audit-rights sentence intact; if you are adding a separate security exhibit, it must be explicitly referenced in the order form (Section 3.2 or similar).

Ben (cc) — can you advise on the technical feasibility for the scoped test account and logs retention?

We'll aim to provide initial redline comments by Monday. If Redwood can offer a short call to walk through the pen-test flow that'd speed things up.

—Sofia
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
ArborHealth
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Legal Team <legal@arborhealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arborhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — legal gate review and evidence ramp

Hi Sofia / Arbor Legal,

I reviewed the attached redlines and sketched three concise edits that should address procurement's concerns while preserving Arbor's audit rights:

1) Order form linkage — add a single sentence to the order form (new §3.2.4) "The Security Exhibit, attached hereto and incorporated by reference, describes the parties' obligations with respect to audit rights, penetration testing, and evidence deliveries." This keeps the audit-rights anchor intact.
2) Pen-test guardrail language — proposed: "Vendor shall provide time-limited, role-scoped credentials for testing that restricts actions to read-only inference calls; Vendor will disable any persistent access following test completion and provide an attestation of no data export."
3) Evidence cadence — offer a contractual commitment for quarterly consolidated SOC2 evidence packages, with an option for ad-hoc extracts for material audits subject to the reasonable expense clause.

I'll attach a short doc with precise redline snippets (see redlines-security-exhibit.docx). If Arbor's legal wants different wording for the attestation, flag it and we can iterate.

If helpful, Vanessa / I can join the Monday call to walk through the redline snippets.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Cho <ben.cho@arborhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arborhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — legal gate review and evidence ramp

Markus, quick technical notes from Security: we can live with the staged plan if the following are confirmed:

- Scoped credentials must be mTLS or short-lived OAuth tokens tied to a test principal; static keys are a non-starter.
- Network-level segmentation: penetration tests must originate from a vendor-owned test subnet or Arbor-approved test IPs; production acceptance testing requires read-only interfaces and an exclusive test tenancy when possible.
- Logs: retention of request/response metadata for 90 days minimum and an immutable copy (write-once) for 1 year for audit purposes.
- KMS/HSM: we need an attestation that customer keys are not exported to third parties and a description of key management lifecycle (rotate, revoke).

If Redwood can confirm these four items, we'll move the exhibit forward internally. Also please include an example of the attestation statement you plan to provide post-test.

Best,
Ben Cho
Head of Security Operations
ArborHealth
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arborhealth.com>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@arborhealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — legal gate review and evidence ramp

Thanks, all — summary / proposed commitments from Redwood to close open items: 

- Pen-test credentials: we'll provide short-lived OAuth tokens (15-minute TTL) scoped to inference read-only methods; tokens issued from a dedicated test principal.
- Network segregation: Redwood will offer a vendor test subnet for the initial blackbox window; for production acceptance testing we will coordinate a narrow IP allowlist or a temporary test tenancy per Arbor request.
- Logs: we commit to 90-day request/response metadata retention and to export an immutable audit bundle for 1 year on request.
- KMS/HSM attestation: we'll supply a standard attestation statement and a short KMS lifecycle note; we cannot export customer keys but will document rotation/revoke practices.
- Evidence cadence: contract to reference quarterly consolidated SOC 2 packages + ad-hoc extracts on request (reasonable expense).

Action items and owners:
- Markus: finalize the redline snippets for order-form linkage and the attestation language (target: Mon EOD).
- Vanessa: schedule 30-min legal gate review on Mon (sent calendar invite).
- Priyom: circulate the pen-test playbook excerpt and the sample attestation text into the shared Drive folder (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_security_exhibit
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/6789/deal/ARB-2027-0457

I'll stand by to jump on the call to clarify any technical constraints.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation after internal review and the Monday call:

- Markus will deliver the redline snippets and attach the attestation template by EOD Monday (we agreed language will be limited and prescriptive).
- Priyom to upload the pen-test-playbook excerpt and the sample attestation to the Drive (done).
- Redwood will update the security exhibit to reference the order form section per Markus' suggested insertion.
- Agreed audit evidence cadence: quarterly consolidated SOC2 package, with ad-hoc extracts available subject to a nominal fee; we captured that in the doc.
- Pen-test schedule: initial vendor staging test in the week of 5/17; production read-only smoke test scheduled for a mutually agreed date after contract signature.

Next steps for Arbor: please confirm the procurement path (PO vs order form amendment) and whether procurement requires any additional internal approvals once the exhibit is updated.

I'll follow up with the calendar invite for the staging window planning session and include test-scoping notes. Thanks again for the speedy turnaround.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
